approval: Apply the latest agreed consistent-control comparisons. Explicitly include NPC/stock pills on the right of Recipe Book item-window ingredient lines.
baseline: Complete Compact Choice Quantities working snapshot, not HEAD alone
implementation: One SourceAvailabilityBadges adapter reuses the established MarketCountBadges vocabulary and Opportunities materials. No negative-stock shorthand: stock and positive preorders are separate.
Need First NPC/stock indicators and Recipe Book checked-stock pills use that shared presentation. Existing data sources, checked facts and manual refresh behavior are retained.
Opportunities calculation, Best Use, exchange and substitute availability share the same badges, including exact counts and unknown states. Market details remain reachable.

Joined item-reference ingredients and alternatives show right-aligned NPC/stock/preorder pills in Recipe and Used for, across all existing callers. At constrained widths or larger text, the badge rail reflows below the name without shrinking text.

Item references reuse PlannerChoiceMarket and the app-owned region/item-ID broker. Verified NPC sources take precedence; nonmarket/unlisted items do not get invented stock. Quote and book freshness remain independently five minutes. Identity changes and close cancel work. No polling, separate client or saved field was added.
The market scope is a captured InheritedTheme so references opened through Recipe Book dialogs retain the shared repository. Live region changes invalidate the open reference immediately.

Need First silver values and total reuse compact comma-decimal k/m/b/t amounts, real Silver art and click-to-expand. Recipe Book profit/route summaries and the remaining Opportunities readouts use the shared formatter. Exact editable fields and price ladders are untouched.
Shopping list and AFK list copy success use the existing small root-overlay top toast, as do copied names. Clipboard errors remain actionable notices. Exact copied text is unchanged.
preserved: All three active themes, theme switching and existing appearance settings
Names copy; separate substitute actions; quantities beside names; auto-height and contained scrolling
Underlying quantities, silver values, plans, grades, Auto decisions, math and catalog/reference data
Full inherited native single-instance, shared Documents, writer-lease, migration and update safeguards
Distinct editable Recipe Book route/grade preview controls and passive noninteractive information semantics

verification.fixtures: Disposable synthetic profiles and a fake shared-market transport; no personal-profile reads or live-market queries
verification.actualApp: Citron Juice opened through Recipe Book in all three themes, normal/double text, right-edge alignment, full-recipe fit, copy/toast, EU-to-NA invalidation, cancellation and no unexpected saved-state changes
verification.regressions: Shared badge states, enlarged preorder digits, silver expansion, queue selectors, sculpted panels, nested references, routes, actions, scroll containment, repository behavior and freshness
verification.limitations: Targeted suites, not the entire repository suite. The exploratory sweep found legacy crafting goldens already failing on the unchanged baseline; those unrelated snapshots are not overwritten. Changed exchange/recipe/Best Use/missing-stock goldens were visually reviewed and refreshed.

deployment: Separate complete Windows Release runnable only. Not launched, installed, handed off or published. Public migration/lifecycle gates and user review remain separate.
